minecraft:written_book_content.title: Settlement Field Notes
minecraft:written_book_content.author: Open-Air Settlement
pages: {"text": "Village visits\n\nTrade normally with emeralds. Villagers need their workstations to restock. Offers rotate at the first restock each day. Workstation reroll protection is unreliable with custom trades; daily rotation removes the need to rely on it. Explorer map offers are protected."}

{"text": "Trading balance\n\nSensible Trade Overhaul supplies the offers. Smiths sell iron equipment rather than diamond equipment. Journeyman armorers may sell 3 iron for 8 emeralds. Master masons can sell sand, red sand and gravel."}

{"text": "Prices and supplies\n\nSupply is finite. Reputation and demand still affect prices; discounts are capped at25%. Level villagers through trade to access more wares. Modded professions keep their own offers. Visit tomorrow if a trade is missing."}

{"text": "Gathering\n\nRight-click mature crops to harvest and replant. Fishing Real reels in supported live fish. Carry On: sneak and right-click with empty hands to lift supported blocks or mobs; right-click to place."}
